item.entropyinversion.entropy_inversion_: Right-click to aim; crouch and right-click to select an attack mode.
Click briefly to lock a target · Hold 1 second to strike.
Crouch + right-click to change attack mode.
attack_mode.entropyinversion.entropy_inv: Erases blocks and entities in a full-height cylinder around the target. Creative and Spectator players are spared.
attack_mode.entropyinversion.asteroid_bo: A meteor sized to the selected crater radius descends slowly during the cutscene. Impact clears blocks above the target height, carves a crater, and leaves a proportional mixed-magma meteorite remnant amid scorched terrain.
attack_mode.entropyinversion.anti_organi: Releases microbots that eliminate living entities throughout the full-height radius. Blocks are untouched; Creative and Spectator players are spared.
